record.rationale: Adapts browser keyboard events to canonical command-registry shortcut strings at the LibreOffice `framework/source/accelerators/keymapping.cxx` ownership boundary. This is a browser-owned adaptation without a direct native source mapping.
responsibilities: Adapts browser keyboard events to canonical command-registry shortcut strings at the LibreOffice `framework/source/accelerators/keymapping.cxx` ownership boundary.
TaskFZA8S9 maps the actual browser multiply key to original MULTIPLY accelerator identity for shared consumers;modifier ordering and text-control ownership remain unchanged.
TaskSRFT0T maps actual browser backtick to original QUOTELEFT for Calc Show Formulas and all shared consumers;modifier ordering/text ownership remain unchanged.

Native QUOTELEFT captions use the actual backtick glyph in the common Writer/Calc generator;the shared canonical normalizer maps both that glyph and native key identity to QUOTELEFT. Browser events and configured shortcuts therefore resolve identically without raw internal names in menus.

stackDivergence.rationale: Browser keyboard, Intl locale, and Worker APIs replace native framework services.
